query.text: 学习助手，请陪我们一起学习，留意坐姿是否规范，有问题提醒我们纠正。
query.text_en: Learning Assistant, please study with us, monitor whether our sitting posture is proper, and remind us to correct it if there are any issues.

annotation.text_zh: 你有些驼背了，把背挺直吧。
annotation.text_en: You're slouching a bit, straighten your back.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
